commits.author: Yoann Manvieu
commits.message:
- refactor to be multi-modules
- some business logic moved to domain model (DDD)
- move to Java 1.8
- move to Spring-boot 1.5
- use Querydsl
- use Spring-session (hash-map in Dev, jdbc otherwise)
- use Spring-security-messaging to allow more fine-grained access with Stomp
- use built-in Spring ApplicationContextPublisher instead of Guava's bus
- use JdbcToken for persisting remember-me tokens
- switch @version entities column to long (datetime precision with potential fails)
- add @Transactional on most repositories and services
- use of CDN for most JS dependencies
- add spring-retry to avoid Yahoo bad QoS (404/502/504 error response)
- add ActiveMQ JMS support for notification between trading-data-collect and trading-webapp
- use Lombok in DTO
- use Mapstruct instead of ModelMapper
- recaptcha feature can be disabled in configuration

commits.message:
/!\ version change 1.1.0 -> 2.0.0 /!\
App name / package structure changed ("package by feature" instead of "package by layer")

- user can buy/sell stocks and currencies
- almost full-responsive design (tables too large in smallest screen portrait mode) 
- default currency when creating user can be changed
- multiple providers can be used simultaneously
- data collect of wider range of symbols 
- cron scheduler is used by default instead of fixedRate
- refactor symbol/portofolio pages by using JQuery's Datatable


[REMOVE] minor/deprecated currencies

commits.author: Yoann Manvieu
